jobDescription: A subscription-analytics software company feeds its customer-facing dashboards from a product event-tracking pipeline. The data engineer is the accountable owner of that pipeline, builds and tests the dbt models for the event tables, runs the data-quality incident rota and agrees data contracts with the teams that produce events. The role also holds the pipeline's share of the cloud data-warehouse budget and answers for it at the quarterly cost review. The data platform group has six engineers and reports to the head of data.
requirements: Has been the accountable owner of a production data pipeline, approving schema changes.
Builds dbt models with automated data tests.
Runs data-quality incident response for the pipeline.
Agrees data contracts with event-producing teams.
Holds and manages a cloud data-warehouse budget.

evidence.text: Data engineer at Brindle Analytics from March 2020 to April 2024, working on the product event-tracking pipeline behind the customer-facing dashboards, which ingests web, mobile and billing events.
Built and maintained the dbt models for the event tables, with not-null, uniqueness and accepted-value tests running on every pull request.
Ran the data-quality incident rota for the pipeline, opening an incident whenever a freshness check failed and writing the follow-up for each, with the cause, the fix and any backfill needed.

Agreed data contracts with three producer teams (web app, mobile and billing) setting out event names, required fields and a change-notice period, and reviewed each contract with its producer team every six months.
Reported the pipeline's monthly warehouse spend to the head of data and proposed table-partitioning changes, which the head of data approved and the candidate then implemented.
Work sample: the data contract agreed with the billing team, with the event schema, field definitions, a 30-day change-notice clause and the signatures of both team leads.
HR verification note: employment at Brindle Analytics (March 2020 to April 2024) was checked against the payroll record supplied by the former employer.

Reference check summary: the former vice president of data confirmed in writing that from 2022 the candidate was the named owner of the event-tracking pipeline, with approval rights over every schema change to the event tables.
